modalities.evidence: resting state high density EEG data (64 or 128 channels)

output.population: 38 participants in three groups: amputees with phantom limb pain, amputees without phantom limb pain, and intact, pain free controls.
output.summary: Resting-state high-density EEG recorded with eyes open or closed from amputees with phantom limb pain, amputees without it, and pain-free controls, organised in BIDS, with session-level pain questionnaire data.
